files.role: Public string-map update entries, conversion/translators and transaction-internal mutation helper. Reexported types/functions are independent of persistence IO.
ranges: SPDX/module docs group dataset config,table metadata,schema metadata,field metadata as HashMap<String,String> edits; None documented as delete and replace selects whole-map versus merge. Import DeepSizeOf. Replacement implementation has a narrower None behavior than that general introduction.

UpdateMapEntry derives Debug/Clone/DeepSizeOf/PartialEq, public key:String/value:Option<String>. From<(String,Option<String>)> moves both fields unchanged with no validation; None is a deletion token in incremental use.

From<(String,String)> wraps Some and delegates; From<(&str,Option<&str>)> allocates owned key and optional owned value; From<(&str,&str)> delegates borrowed optional conversion. Empty strings and duplicate keys are accepted; allocation is ordinary, no Result.

UpdateMap derives Debug/Clone/DeepSizeOf/PartialEq and publicly owns ordered Vec<UpdateMapEntry> and replace:bool. Derived equality observes entry order even when two lists have identical map effects. No Default, sorting, deduplication or contradiction checks.

pub(super) apply_update_map mutates supplied target and returns unit. For replace=true it clears target, then inserts only Some(value) entries in list order, cloning key/value. None entries are skipped, not removals from earlier inserted values. Thus [(k,Some(v)),(k,None)] leaves v in replacement mode; last Some for a key wins regardless of later None. Empty replacement clears all entries; clear may retain capacity. No atomic rollback.

For replace=false, process entries in order: Some inserts cloned strings, None removes matching key. Last entry wins, including a deletion following an insert; deleting absent key is harmless. Empty incremental update preserves target. No validation, errors, IO or allocation rollback; expected hash work linear in entries apart from key/hash costs.

translate_config_updates borrows upsert HashMap and deletion String slice, allocates entry Vec, clones all upserts first in unspecified HashMap iteration order, then emits deletion entries preserving supplied order and duplicates. Returns replace=false. A key in both lists is removed by apply_update_map because deletes come last; translator itself changes no map. No preallocation or validation.

translate_schema_metadata_updates clones borrowed HashMap entries into all-Some vector in unspecified order and returns replace=true. Empty map means full clear when applied. It is a translation of old-style schema metadata semantics, not a compatibility codec itself. The complete codec is now analyzed: legacy UpdateConfig invokes these translators (rust/lance-table/src/transaction/proto.rs:315-345). No tests/async/unsafe/locks in this file.
